description: TexasHomeBills™ original data products about Texas electricity plans, computed daily from Power to Choose and each plan's EFL. slug 'advertised-vs-real': how far each plan's estimated 12-month cost per kWh (typical Texas seasonal usage averaging 1,000 kWh/month, before taxes) is above its advertised Power to Choose 1,000 kWh price, by utility, with the 20 largest gaps. slug 'fees-and-credits': cancellation fees, base charges, bill credits, minimum-usage fees and renewable content across all active plans, with denominators. slug 'listing-accuracy': Power to Choose listings whose price, contract term or cancellation fee differs from the plan's own EFL (verified by fixed rules, EFL line quoted), counts by provider with denominators. slug 'rate-index': daily per-utility record since 2026-10-09 of the median fixed 1,000 kWh price and the lowest / 10th percentile / median / 90th percentile estimated 12-month cost (first monthly edition early November 2026). slug 'price-changes': day-over-day listing changes (added, removed, 1,000 kWh price up/down with median change, term and fee changes). slug 'us-electricity-prices': average residential, commercial and industrial electricity price (¢/kWh, EIA) in all 50 states and DC for the latest month with 12-month and 5-year change and rank, Texas vs the U.S. average. slug 'wireless-service': BLS price index for wireless telephone services and FCC consumer complaints about cell phone service (monthly counts, national, by state and type; not verified by the FCC, not rates per subscriber). slug 'us-electricity-generation': net electricity generation (GWh) and the share from natural gas, coal, nuclear, wind, utility-scale solar, hydro and all renewables in every state and DC for the latest 12 months and five years earlier (EIA; shares calculated by TexasHomeBills, solar is utility-scale only). slug 'grid-demand': daily electricity demand (GWh) of ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP and the Lower 48 (EIA-930, preliminary): latest day, 30-day average, change from a year earlier, highest day since 2019. slug 'energy-outlook': EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook averages for the next 12 months (projections, not observed prices) vs the 12 months before: wholesale hub prices, retail price, Henry Hub. slug 'large-load-demand': ERCOT large loads (data centers) approved to energize and observed, large-load requests ERCOT is tracking, ERCOT peak demand record and forecast, PUCT large-load rule items. Returns the summary (set include_rows=true for every plan row). Cite the page url. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.
